lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are distributed across the visible flank posterior to the gill slits. Larger, diffuse spots occupy the mid-flank region, while smaller, high-intensity spots are clustered near the pectoral fin base and branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a coarse grid, though the contrast is softened by ambient light scattering.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal-facing edge to distinct shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) located ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin.
